description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for articles in an ASP.NET Core project, including a command, validation, and a handler to delete an article based on its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article identified by its slug using Entity Framework Core.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Handles the deletion request asynchronously, throwing a NotFound exception if the article does not exist.
